title: Local branches per project

metrics.name: git.branches
metrics.label: веток
metrics.means: How many local branches each of the project's checkouts holds, summed. A branch that exists on no remote is work this machine is the only copy of, which is what `clone.local-only-branch` reports one at a time; this counts them so the trend is visible.

why: Track local branch counts across each project over time. Changes in the count complement repository findings about work that has not reached a remote.
